install.note: Central publishes the native source contract cargo install --path ctrl. Pre-release O:I fetches and verifies this immutable tested integration commit directly.

verification.note: O:I invokes Central's own doctor operation and preserves its exit status/output without reinterpreting Central health.

surfaces.compatibility: O:I requires ctrl --version plus structured action.list containing central.init, central.doctor, and action.list. The source contract remains pinned to the tested Central integration commit until the Rust Wayfinder is promoted to main/release.
